definitions.explanation: A break or pause between activities; spare time during a busy schedule.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{合間|あいま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: I drink coffee between work tasks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{合間|あいま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{話|はな}した→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: I talked with friends between classes.

examples.japanese: {合間|あいま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけて→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}する→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
examples.english: I study whenever I find spare moments.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{合間|あいま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: between work tasks
- {合間|あいま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つける→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧: to find spare time
- {合間|あいま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{縫|ぬ}って→縫う：00326_nuu⟧: squeezing in between (activities)
- ちょっとした{合間|あいま}に: during a brief interval

USAGE:
{合間|あいま} emphasizes using small pockets of time productively or for brief activities.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧: between, interval (more general)
- ⟦{休憩|きゅうけい}→休憩：00262_kyuukei⟧: break, rest
- ⟦{隙間|すきま}→隙間：00389_sukima⟧: gap, crack (physical)
